thread:
Nina: Quick sync — prepping the marketplace listing bundle for AWS/GCP/Azure. Need owners on hero art, two screenshots (UI + infra diagram), short product blurb (<= 140 chars), quickstart for each cloud, AMI/container/image URIs, pricing matrix (trial vs paid), and legal assets (EULA + logo approvals). Who can pick what?
Omar: I can take hero + screenshots. Will produce PNGs and a web-optimized JPG. Need the 140-char blurb from product. ETA EOD Thu. :thumbsup:
Leah: Docs will do the quickstarts and the markdown landing page content. I need sample credentials & minimal infra steps for each cloud (Raj?). Also one code sample per cloud (terraform + gcp deployment + azure cli).
Raj: Yep I’ll hand over AMI IDs and container URIs. Working on an example Terraform snippet for AWS Marketplace. Will also provide a small ARM template and a GCP container config. Target: tomorrow morning.
Nina: @Omar can you also draft the 1-liner? Keep it focused on "predictable low-latency inference" and "single API for hosted/dedicated/private".
Omar: Drafted: "Redwood Inference — predictable, production-grade LLM inference: hosted API, dedicated pools, and private deployments." Thoughts?
Leah: Clean. I’ll use that for the docs intro. Also need a short note about telemetry/data sharing — legal review required.
Dave (Legal): Can confirm EULA + telemetry language. We need to add the standard data-processing paragraph and an opt-out note for telemetry collection in the marketplace listing. I can send the redline by EOD. Also request for trademarked logo usage — share vector files.
Nina: Good. For trials: we plan a 14-day trial SKU with usage cap. @Raj can you add entitlement/SKU id placeholder so billing can wire it?
Raj: Adding placeholder: SKU-TRIAL-REDWOOD-14D (will replace with final after billing ack). Also attaching a small snippet for the listing metadata we typically send to AWS: 
```
{
  "product_name": "Redwood Inference",
  "short_description": "Predictable production LLM inference",
  "ami_ids": {"us-east-1": "ami-0abc1234def", "us-west-2": "ami-0def5678ghij"},
  "trial_sku": "SKU-TRIAL-REDWOOD-14D",
  "pricing_tiers": ["trial", "standard", "enterprise"]
}
```
Leah: Perfect, I’ll reference that in the AWS quickstart. For GCP/Azure docs I’ll include container image URIs and marketplace template IDs slots.
marketplace-bot: New Asana task created: "Marketplace listing: landing assets + docs" assigned to Nina, deadline 2026-03-26. Link: https://app.asana.com/0/123456789/987654321
Nina: Thanks bot. Action items recap: Omar = hero + 1-liner (EOD Thu), Raj = AMI/container/template + SKU placeholder (tomorrow AM), Leah = quickstarts + landing markdown (tomorrow EOD), Dave = EULA redline + telemetry text (EOD). I’ll compile and push to the listing folder once we have assets.
Omar: Adding note — hero should be 1200x600 px, transparent background optional, include small "Works with Redwood" badge.
Leah: Docs needs sample CLI commands and a minimal env var table. Also we should include a troubleshooting FAQ with common permission errors.
Dave (Legal): One more: include a short privacy blurb of max 2 sentences for the marketplace listing page — I’ll draft and send.
Nina: Great. If anyone hits blockers ping me here. I’ll start the PR for the listing artifacts repo once we have the images + docs. :white_check_mark:
